description: UK business verification (KYB) risk check in one call: company status and age, overdue accounts or confirmation statement, insolvency history, disputed or undeliverable office, owners (PSC), outstanding charges, and each current director screened against the disqualified directors register. Returns a 0-100 risk score, level and flags. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).
